im-f0490d27025df4a1e3094e5246569dcc-0003.caption: Fig. 3. Illustration ofthree ways ofupdate in grid archive. The figure illustrates three scenarios for updating solutions in the feature space after applying the HS operators. The solution is updated in two scenarios: 1) If the corresponding cel is empty, the newly generated solution is archived directly to the cell. 2) If the targeted cell is already occupied, the new solution will only replace the existing one if it offers a better performance; otherwise, the new solution will be ignored.

footnotes: Haoxiang Qin received the B.S. and M.S. degrees from the School of Computer Science, Liaocheng University, Liaocheng, China.
